name: Raisin: Agricultural Product Morphology Classification
description: The Raisin dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository is an agricultural vision-derived benchmark comprising 900 instances across two prominent Turkish raisin cultivars (Kecimen and Besni, with 450 instances per class). Grain samples were digitized using an industrial Computer Vision System (CVS) to measure detailed exterior geometry, texture, and seed morphology. From the captured images, seven continuous morphological attributes were extracted: Area, MajorAxisLength, MinorAxisLength, Eccentricity, ConvexArea, Extent, and Perimeter. The dataset enables rigorous benchmarking of classification algorithms, feature selection methods, and automated quality-sorting systems in post-harvest fruit processing.
